**STEP 1 - Scene:** A chicken and leafy salad in a white oval bowl, photographed from above at a slight angle. The bowl is the only vessel in frame.

**STEP 2 - Ruler:** The bowl's longest undistorted width is about 24 cm, so I treat it as a 24 cm diameter. Area = 3.14 × 12² ≈ 452 cm².

**STEP 3 - Items:** Cooked chicken breast cubes, mixed salad leaves (rocket/spinach-type), broccoli florets, and a few small brown crouton-like pieces. No dressing is clearly visible, so none is counted.

**STEP 4 - Area:** Chicken ~45% (≈203 cm²), leaves ~30% (≈136 cm²), broccoli ~8% (≈36 cm²), croutons ~3% (≈14 cm²). Total ≈86% of the bowl is covered by food, which fits the photo.

**STEP 5 - Volume:** Chicken 203 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 305 ml. Leaves 136 cm² × 3 cm ≈ 407 ml. Broccoli 36 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 72 ml. Croutons 14 cm² × 1 cm ≈ 14 ml.

**STEP 6 - Grams:** Chicken 305 ml × 0.9 ≈ 274 g. Leaves 407 ml × 0.15 ≈ 61 g. Broccoli 72 ml × 0.6 ≈ 43 g. Croutons 14 ml × 0.3 ≈ 4 g. Total ≈ 382 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Chicken 274 g × 165 kcal/100 g ≈ 452 kcal. Leaves 61 g × 25 ≈ 15 kcal. Broccoli 43 g × 34 ≈ 15 kcal. Croutons 4 g × 400 ≈ 17 kcal. Total ≈ 499 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** A bowl about 86% covered with chicken and greens, around 380 g, is plausible. Chicken dominates the energy. The estimate excludes any dressing, which would add energy if present.
